summary: Created and installed “OS Comparison Root CA” on node1. System trust validation succeeds, and the CA persisted across the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Installed OpenSSL from the configured RHEL repository.
Generated a local 4096-bit RSA private key with root-only 0600 permissions.
Created a self-signed CA certificate with critical CA and certificate-signing extensions.
Installed the certificate in RHEL’s system trust anchors and regenerated the trust store.
Restarted node1 once and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the certificate, private key, and system trust remained healthy after restart.

evidence.requirement: Create the local certificate authority named OS Comparison Root CA
evidence.summary: Created the key and certificate. Verification shows the requested subject, CA:TRUE, certificate-signing usage, matching key/certificate public keys, and secure file permissions.

evidence.requirement: Install the certificate as a trusted system certificate authority
evidence.summary: Regenerated RHEL system trust; OpenSSL reports OK and p11-kit identifies OS Comparison Root CA as a trusted authority anchor.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 7223d5b7-fa56-4ff3-acee-959a5cf5f146, received restart acknowledgement, observed new boot ID c627a508-5e40-4ad5-a0da-4bdde6f0a1f3, and confirmed the same CA fingerprint, matching key, permissions, OpenSSL verification, and trusted-anchor record after recovery.
